name: causal-impact-campaign
description: Measure the causal impact of marketing campaigns, promos, or interventions on business metrics using Bayesian structural time series. Full pipeline: data exploration, covariate engineering, 9-method analysis, Specification Curve Analysis (440-spec robustness sweep), permutation validation, placebo calibration, methodology communication guide (verified tfcausalimpact p-value formula, identification assumptions, 'three tests, three different questions' framing, 'diagnose, don't demote' protocol with worked example and placebo-rank implementation gotchas), CausalPy v0.4+ wrapper debugging (InferenceData API + prior-scale standardisation + post-window bound), pre-delivery review-panel quality gate, and client-facing deliverables. Includes merged permutation-validation, bsts-placebo-calibration, and causalpy-wrapper-debug skills.
